prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a single square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, clear at 384 by 384 pixels. Saturated character colors, simple chunky shapes, a strong readable silhouette and one visual joke. Large centered subject with comfortable margins, minimal scenery. Modest detail appropriate for a small card. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, border, card frame or separate panels. Do not imitate an existing copyrighted card illustration. Subject: One gigantic glossy chestnut-brown cockroach as a fantasy monster, three-quarter view, wearing a tiny dented metal helmet that is far too small for its head. Exactly six clearly separated insect legs, two long antennae, folded wing covers, no human arms. Its front pair of legs grip a stolen oversized steel knight helmet like a trophy.
